newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins consolidate at higher levels.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins consolidate at higher levels.

text.p: Russian MinFin bonds steadied at higher levels compared with late Friday, tracking last week's rally of U.S. Treasuries amid confidence U.S. interest rates should remain on hold, dealers said on Monday.

MinFins, like other emerging debt, are sensitive to any news which would suggest a change in U.S. interest rates and consequently affect U.S. Treasury bond prices. The latter rose on Friday after friendly May PPI data, dealers said.
"The situation is mixed, as we are seeing both good buying and good selling," one dealer said. "It all started after the rise in Treasuries, but now people are apparently squaring their positions."
Most Bank dealer Alexander Rodionov said the market was in a period of consolidation.
"There was no rise today, just consolidation on the levels of Friday," he said.
Dealers said prices of MinFin tranches from 3 to 7 were running into resistance at 90.30, 67.30, 48.40, 54.50 and 41.20 respectively.
